warnings: The story scenario is primarily UI-focused and does not mandate API validation beyond pagination parameter usage.

testCases.title: Verify that GET /products with page query returns products for specified page
contractChecks: response properties: current_page, data, from, last_page, per_page, to, total are present and of correct types
testCases.notes: This test validates the API pagination parameter by requesting page 2 and checking the current_page in response.
